name: ONLYOFFICE Docs
tagline: Browser editors built around Microsoft's file formats
description: Online editors for documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDFs and forms that use .docx, .xlsx and .pptx as their native formats. It plugs into a file platform such as Nextcloud or Seafile, and there are free desktop and mobile editors as well.
licenseNote: The free Community build is limited to 20 simultaneous editing connections; larger teams need a paid licence. In 2026 Nextcloud, IONOS and others forked the editors as Euro-Office after a dispute over ONLYOFFICE's additional licence terms, and ONLYOFFICE suspended its partnership with Nextcloud. Check which office integration your file platform currently supports before committing.
backing: Ascensio System SIA, headquartered in Latvia. The Russian origins of its development team were cited by Nextcloud as one reason for the 2026 Euro-Office fork.

maturity.rationale: Widely deployed and polished, with the best Microsoft-format fidelity of the open options. It loses a point for the connection cap on the free build and for the unsettled 2026 fork and partnership dispute.

selfHosting.summary: A single Docker container, but it is only an editor: it needs a file platform such as Nextcloud or Seafile in front of it, and a JWT secret shared between the two.

requirements.notes: Run it on a separate host name from your file platform, behind HTTPS.

deploy.label: Official Docker image and Compose file

managedHosting.label: ONLYOFFICE DocSpace (cloud)
managedHosting.note: Hosted rooms and editors run by the vendor; free tier for small teams

strengths: Uses .docx, .xlsx and .pptx as its native formats, so Microsoft files survive round trips better than anywhere else
Familiar ribbon-style interface eases the move for Office users
Real-time co-editing, comments and tracked changes in the browser
Free desktop and mobile editors for offline work
weaknesses: The free Community build stops at 20 concurrent connections
VBA macros are not supported; it has its own JavaScript macro system
Governance and trust questions after the 2026 fork: see the licence note

featureNotes.browser-coediting: Up to 20 simultaneous connections in the free build
featureNotes.odf-native: Opens and saves ODF by converting
